_readme: The whole edit. Change anything and rerun edit_short.py; tools/promo/README.md explains every field. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_times: Any time below is seconds, or a moment in your voiceover: "hook" (the line starts), "hook.end" (it ends), "hook.64" (the word 64 is said; "hook.the#2" is the second "the"), or "end" (the video ends). Add an offset to any of them: "hook.64-0.2", "end-3".

output._tail: seconds after the last word before the video ends; set "duration" to fix the length instead

music._swell: how much the music rises in the pauses you asked for with pause_before
music._duck: the music drops about 11 dB under your voice; a bigger ratio or a lower threshold ducks harder

whisper.prompt: Clash Royale, Hog Rider, Musketeer, Cannon, Giant, Fireball, GitHub.
whisper._model: small.en is more accurate and about 3x slower; the transcript is cached per recording either way

style._sizes: pixels on a 1080-wide frame; *_y are fractions of the height (0 top, 1 bottom). YouTube's buttons cover the bottom ~20% and the right edge, so keep captions above 0.75

_lines: What you say, one entry per line, in order. *word* is highlighted; " / " forces a caption break (otherwise captions hold up to max_words words). "caption": false says a line without a caption. "pause_before": 2.5 makes sure there are at least 2.5 s of silence before the line: read straight through, and the edit inserts the silence into your recording and lets the music swell there. The id is how shots and effects refer to the line.

lines.text: I built an AI / to play Clash Royale / from scratch.
First, I rebuilt / the whole game, / so it runs *20,000 times* / faster than real time.
Then I let it train. / And it got... / *creative.*
When a Hog Rider / charges your tower, / you drop a Cannon / in the middle / to pull it away.
My AI / put its Cannon... / *behind its own King.*
It wasn't dumb. / It found a hole / in *my* reward: / losing the Cannon / cost points. / Hiding it / cost *nothing.*
Even while making / *this video,* / I found / *another bug* / in the game. / A Fireball / knocked my Giant / off the bridge, / and it got stuck, / *vibrating,* / for *22 seconds.*
It happened / in *18%* / of matches. / Fixed.

It also refused / to play Fireball. / I thought / that was a bug. / It wasn't. / It had played / *30,000 games* / against its own deck, / where / the best Fireball / usually hit / just *one* troop. / So it decided / Fireball / wasn't *worth it.*
So I gave it / one superpower: / before every move, / it plays out its options / *4 seconds* / into the future.
The network wanted / a *Hog Rider.* / The future said...
Its win rate / against my bot / went from *62%* / to *94%.*
This is the link / to my project, / if you want / to *check it out.*

_shots: Which clip plays when. A shot runs until the next one starts (the first always starts at 0). clip: a file in clips_dir. in: where in the clip to start (seconds), or "continue" to pick up where the previous shot of the same clip left off (a jump cut to a new framing). speed: 0.5 is half speed. zoom: one number, or [from, to] for a slow push over the shot. focus: the point to zoom toward, [x, y] as fractions of the frame, or [[x, y], [x, y]] to pan. overscan: how far (a fraction of the frame) the camera may look past the clip's edge, to slide something low in the clip up out from under YouTube's buttons. caption_y: this shot's caption height. sync: land a moment of the clip on a moment of your voice, by "beat" (a name from the clip's .beats.json) or "clip" (seconds), shifting "in" to fit, or with "fit": "stretch" changing the speed instead. label: the small note in the corner; it comes from the clip itself ("Recreated in the engine") unless you set it. sfx: the sound on the cut (null for none).

shots._in: starts mid pull-back, so all 64 boards are on screen by 3 s

shots._sync: the Musketeer survives the Fireball on 32 HP; our tower finishes it as the voice says "worth it"

shots._found: A STAGED board (tools/promo/boards/triple_elixir.json; the clip says so): triple elixir, sudden death. Their left tower is nearly dead, so the network wants to finish it with a Hog Rider; the lookahead sees the push coming down the right lane and throws a Fireball. Critic scores vs doing nothing: Hog Rider +0.45, Fireball +0.85 (kills 6), Cannon +0.37, Ice Spirit +0.04. Played out from the frozen board, 32 games each with the network playing on: Fireball wins 25, Hog Rider 3, Cannon 5, Ice Spirit 0, doing nothing 3. Rendered with: ghost_trails.py --board tools/promo/boards/triple_elixir.json --lead 4 --think 3

shots._zoom: unzoomed: the corner note and the winning score sit at opposite edges

_effects: Moments on top of the shots. Every effect has "at"; most take "duration" (seconds) or "until" (a time). punch: a quick zoom-in (scale, focus, "hold": true to stay in). shake: strength in pixels. flash: a white flash (color). freeze: the picture holds while the voice goes on. callout: big text (text, color, size, y). counter: a number counting up (from, to, format, hold, prefix, suffix). mark: a clean ring (locks onto its target) or arrow (slides in and points) with a white edge and soft shadow: shape, pos [x, y] in the clip's frame, from [x, y] for an arrow's tail, size, color; it stays on its target through zooms. credit: small centred lines on a dark box, like the label (lines, size, y). sfx: just a sound (sound, sfx_db). Any effect takes "sfx" (a sound name, or null) and "sfx_db".
